name: Gravelighter
description: A territorial kami of Jukai Forest with a stone face and a paper lantern, who attacks the group before Himoto commands her to retreat.

timeline.summary: Gravelighter attacks the fleeing group; Kaito shields Eiko and Himoto, and Himoto commands Gravelighter to retreat.
